name: California (Cal/OSHA)

rules.action: PM2.5 {value} µg/m³ (AQI over 500): respirators mandatory, move work to filtered indoor air if possible
AQI {aqi}: hand out N95s, tell the crew, cut exposure
{value}°F: high-heat procedures, pre-shift meeting, watch the crew

note: Smoke rules use the PM2.5 NowCast concentration, as §5141.1 Appendix A does: AQI 151 = 55.5 µg/m³, AQI >500 = 500.5 µg/m³. An AQI threshold of 501 can never trip, because the AQI scale stops at 500.
